usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the parser in `main.go`. I ran it on both examples' input, joined into one test, and the output matched what the task expects.

It reads the input line by line and splits each line on commas outside quotes. A `""` inside a quoted field becomes a literal `"`. Empty lines come out as a single empty field. It also strips a trailing `\r`, so Windows line endings work.

I didn't test any other
